title: Loss of Public Property Status and Limits of Expropriation
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Public property loses status only upon purpose termination
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that property expropriated for a specific public purpose does not lose its public property status except upon the termination of that specific purpose. FAIL if the note does not state that public property status is lost only upon termination of the specific purpose for which the property was expropriated.

criteria.title: State regains discretion after purpose ends
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that once the original purpose ends, the State regains its discretionary authority to end the public property status or reassign it to another public purpose according to general rules. FAIL if the note does not state that the State regains its discretionary authority to end the public property status or reassign it to another public purpose according to general rules after the original purpose ends.

criteria.title: Administration must respect original expropriation purpose
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the administrative authority was required to respect the purpose for which the property was expropriated and must not exceed it to achieve another purpose. FAIL if the note does not state that the administrative authority must respect the original expropriation purpose and must not exceed it to achieve another purpose.

criteria.title: Deviation to another purpose is a violation even if public benefit
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that redirecting the land to a different purpose (even one serving public benefit) constitutes a flagrant violation of expropriation rules (مخالفة صريحة). FAIL if the note does not state that redirecting the land to a different purpose, even one serving public benefit, constitutes a flagrant violation of expropriation rules.

criteria.title: Expropriation is an exception limited to defined boundaries
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that expropriation for public benefit (نزع الملكية للمنفعة العامة) was established only as an exception within specific limits that must not be exceeded. FAIL if the note does not state that expropriation for public benefit was established only as an exception within specific limits that must not be exceeded.
